Hard edges, no gradients, glow, texture, scene, shadow, text or extra objects. References establish scale, register and four-plane language. Retry correction: previous canvas was 1254×1254 and prong approximately 340 pixels long; enforce 512×512 canvas and 70-pixel native prong length.
